metadata.title: feat(api): Add gateway_id filtering to prompts and resources listing endpoints
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Add `gateway_id` query parameter to `GET /prompts` and `GET /resources` endpoints, matching existing `GET /tools` capability
- Add `gateway_id` field to `PromptRead` and `ResourceRead` response schemas so clients can identify which gateway each artifact belongs to
- Support `gateway_id=null` to filter for artifacts with no gateway association

Closes #3638

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `mcpgateway/schemas.py` | Added `gateway_id` field to `PromptRead` and `ResourceRead` |
| `mcpgateway/services/prompt_service.py` | Added `gateway_id` param, cache hash, and WHERE clause to `list_prompts()` |
| `mcpgateway/services/resource_service.py` | Added `gateway_id` param, cache hash, and WHERE clause to `list_resources()` |
| `mcpgateway/main.py` | Added `gateway_id` Query param to both listing endpoints |
| `docs/docs/manage/api-usage.md` | Added `gateway_id` to filtering tables with curl examples |
| `llms/api.md` | Updated to note `gateway_id` works on all three listing endpoints |
| `tests/.../test_prompt_service.py` | 6 new tests for gateway_id filtering |
| `tests/.../test_resource_service.py` | 6 new tests for gateway_id filtering |

## Test plan

- [x] 6 prompt service gateway_id filter tests pass
- [x] 6 resource service gateway_id filter tests pass
- [x] 134/134 existing prompt service tests pass (no regressions)
- [x] 227/227 existing resource service tests pass (no regressions)
- [x] 212/212 existing tool service tests pass (no regressions)
- [x] 35/35 prompt/resource e2e tests pass

commits.message:
feat(api): Add gateway_id filtering to prompts and resources listing endpoints

Add server-side gateway_id filtering to GET /prompts and GET /resources,
matching the existing capability on GET /tools. This eliminates the need
for client-side filtering when retrieving prompts or resources associated
with a specific physical MCP server (gateway).

Closes #3638

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: populate gateway_id in ResourceRead, add limit to prompt cache hash, strengthen tests

- Add gateway_id to convert_resource_to_read() so ResourceRead responses
  actually include the field added to the schema in the prior commit
- Include limit in prompt service cache hash to prevent cache poisoning
  across different page sizes (resource service already had this)
- Add endpoint-level tests verifying gateway_id forwarding from main.py
- Add integration tests for partition completeness and null filtering
- Strengthen unit tests to verify actual SQL WHERE clauses via query
  compilation
- Add gateway_id to resource mock fixtures to fix MagicMock/Pydantic
  validation conflicts
- Fix pre-existing ruff lint errors in touched test files

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
